properties.notes: 5-15 House Supply. Demolition of existing structures and redevelopment by erection of two buildings comprising a three storey northern block and a five storey southern block to provide 23 affordable housing residential units (23x1 bedroom flats) with central courtyard, roof terraces, landscaping, one on-site car parking space and pedestrian access to St John's Terrace and Ladbroke Grove.
